name: Home as an asset
job: answers: what my home costs to keep and why it is not in my FI number

concepts.concept: the home is kept out of the FI number; its upkeep is spending

unlock.text: Always; it does nothing until a home is entered.

coreChanges: core change: the timeline adds the home's upkeep reserve to every year's spending and flags that the home is not counted (engine/projection/timeline.ts, decision A10)

killCriteria.measure: share of homeowners who enter the home
killCriteria.action: keep the reserve as a spending category hint and drop the fields
